description: Look up a transaction on Base or Ethereum mainnet: status (success, failed, pending or not_found), block, confirmations, timestamp, from, to, ETH value, gas used, fee, method id and decoded ERC20 transfers with symbols and amounts. Useful to confirm that a payment arrived. Params: hash (0x transaction hash, required), chain ('base' default or 'ethereum'). Price: $0.002 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base or Solana). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"hash":"0x387b8fce2e62d9466a30840c5f391b7511968bca9b73280c17aefe29d63eb82c","chain":"base"}.
name: evm_tx
title: EVM Transaction Status
